correctness.rationale: Reconstructed inclusion-exclusion over every absent set of the 7 points: signed nonzero factors for Fano are (1,1),(4/7,-7),(2/7,21),(1/7,-21); for 35 triples they are (1,1),(4/7,-7),(2/7,21),(4/35,-35),(1/35,35). Algebra gives the claimed exact gap. The ratio a_t=(4^t-1)/5^t is constant 3/5 at t=1,2 and strictly decreasing for t>=2 because a_t-a_(t+1)=(4^t-4)/5^(t+1). Hence the all-horizon strict order follows analytically. Independent 128-set enumeration and exact tails t=1..11 matched; not an infinite certificate.
